text:
Maria Ops: Heads-up — planning a soft-evac + rolling GPU microcode reboot in us-west1 tomorrow 02:00-04:00 PDT. Targeting ~20% of pool per cohort (40 GPUs), 15m canary between cohorts. We'll reseed KV cache and warm prefix cache after each cohort. Expect brief worker disconnects; app-level retries should handle. Posting runbook below.

infra-bot: Maintenance created: MW-1780056789 | us-west1 gpu-microcode | start 2026-04-10T02:00 PDT | duration 2h

Priya Infra: Any dedicated customers pinned to these nodes? SLA note: if >5% tenant impact we escalate to CS. @Maria Ops can we flag the vip tenants?

Maria Ops: @Priya Infra checking now — two dedicated tenants have small pinned sets but we can migrate them off cohort 2. Will add rollback window in runbook.

Liam SRE: Capacity check — current free GPUs in us-west1 = 210. Draining 40 at a time with 15m canary should keep headroom. Watch queue depth for the image-generation service; it's the biggest spike risk.

Dennis: Sequence? Prefer start with edge racks -> internal -> priority-tenant racks? Also do we have a KV cache seed play for each cohort?

Maria Ops: Sequence: cohort-1 (edge-rack1, rack2) -> cohort-2 (midline priority racks) -> cohort-3 (overflow racks). KV seed plan: run 3 canary inference pods after reboot to prefill prefixes (see command below). Abort criteria: 1) request error rate >1% over 5m, 2) latency 95p > 2x baseline, 3) telemetry agent reports drop >10%.

Maria Ops: Runbook snippet:
```
# soft-evac + reboot
redwoodctl node annotate NODE_ID maintenance=planned
redwoodctl node unsched NODE_ID
redwoodctl service migrate --node NODE_ID --cohort COHORT_NUM
ssh root@NODE_ID 'sudo fw_update --apply; sudo reboot'
# post-reboot: warmkv
kubectl --context=us-west1 run kv-warm --image=redwood/kv-seeder:stable --replicas=3 -- env-vars
```

Eve Platform: I'll create a console alert for per-route latency + a maintenance banner for the dashboard. Put the outage note in the status page with a 'degraded' timeframe rather than full outage.

Priya Infra: Cost shoutout — migrating traffic/placing backfill in other regions will add egress and extra GPU hours. Quick estimate: 8-12% token cost increase for the window, ~USD 2.5k-4k depending on burst. Confirmed this is fine for the maintenance budget?

Dennis: Fine. Can we batch telemetry samples post-cohort to check model quality regressions? I can script the eval run.

Liam SRE: One more ask — can we run a small canary in eu-west1 to validate KV seed behavior and reduce rollback time if we see bad patterns? 3 pods should be enough.

Maria Ops: Agree — will run eu-west1 canary 30m before starting. I'll post final cohort list + node IDs in 30m. Thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled 30m before start: MW-1780056789 will begin at 2026-04-10T02:00 PDT.
